xavier.d: Spanish missionary and Jesuit who establish missionaries in Japan and Ceylon and the East Indies (1506-1552)

xanthorroea.d: grass trees; sometimes placed in family Xanthorrhoeaceae

xanthoma.d: a skin problem marked by the development (on the eyelids and neck and back) of irregular yellow nodules; sometimes attributable to disturbances of cholesterol metabolism

xanthosis.d: an abnormal yellow discoloration of the skin

xanthelasma.d: xanthoma of the eyelids; occurs chiefly in the elderly

xanthophyll.d: yellow carotenoid pigments in plants and animal fats and egg yolks

xanthous.d: of the color intermediate between green and orange in the color spectrum; of something resembling the color of an egg yolk

xanthium.d: coarse herbs having small heads of greenish flowers followed by burrs with hooked bristles

xanthemia.d: excess carotene in the blood stream; can cause the skin to turn a pale yellow or red color

xanthate.d: a salt or ester of xanthic acid

xanthopsia.d: visual defect in which objects appear to have a yellowish hue; sometimes occurs in cases of jaundice

xanthine.d: crystalline oxidation product of the metabolism of nucleoproteins; precursor of uric acid

xanthomonas.d: a genus of bacteria similar to Pseudomonas but producing a yellow pigment that is not soluble in water

xanthic acid.d: any of a class of unstable organic acids containing sulphur
